description: This PHP class represents a Data Transfer Object (DTO) for displaying date fields with aggregation capabilities in reports. It implements string conversion and utilizes a trait for date formatting.

classes.name: GenericDateDisplayFieldWithAggregateDTO
classes.description: A DTO class for managing and formatting date display fields within reports, supporting string conversion.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the object with an optional date string, parsing it into a DateTime object if provided.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Formats the stored DateTime object into a string using a helper trait method.
